verses.text: <pb/><e>Abù; Abù Ọma umu Kora.</e> <pb/><t>Onye uku ka Jehova bu, Ọ bu kwa onye anēto nke-uku,</t> <t>N'obodo Chineke-ayi, bú ugwu nsọ Ya.</t>
<t>Ihe mara nma n'idi-elu, na ihe-obi-utọ nke uwa nile,</t> <t>Ka ugwu Zaion bu, n'akuku nile nke Ugwu,</t> <t>Bú obodo Eze ukwu.</t>
<t>Chineke Nke nọ n'ulo nile ya di elu emewo ka amara Ya na Ya bu ulo-elu.</t>
<t>N'ihi na, le, ndi-eze zukọro,</t> <t>Ha gabigara n'otù.</t>
<t>Ha onwe-ha huru ya, ibobo we nwua ha n'aru;</t> <t>Ha mara jijiji, zọlie ọsọsọ.</t>
<t>Ọma-jijiji jidere ha n'ebe ahu;</t> <t>Ihe-nb͕u, dika nke nwayi nāmuputa nwa.</t>
<t>I ji ifufe Iru-anyanwu</t> <t>Tiwa ub͕ọ nile nke Tashish.</t>
Dika ayi nuworo, otú a ka ayi huworo N'obodo Jehova nke usu nile nke ndi-agha, n'obodo Chineke-ayi: Chineke gēme ka o guzosie ike rue mb͕e ebighi-ebi. Selah
<t>Ayi echèwo ebere-Gi echè, Chineke,</t> <t>N'etiti ulo uku Gi.</t>
<t>Dika aha-Gi si di, Chineke,</t> <t>Otú a ka otuto-Gi di rue nsọtu nile nke uwa:</t> <t>Ezi omume juputara aka-nri-Gi.</t>
<t>Ka ugwu Zaion ṅuria ọṅu,</t> <t>Ka umu-ndinyom Juda tegharia egwú ọṅù,</t> <t>N'ihi ikpé-Gi nile.</t>
<t>Jenu Zaion buruburu, b͕a kwa ya buruburu:</t> <t>Guanu ulo-elu-ya nile ọnu.</t>
<t>Tukwasinu obi-unu n'ékpè-ya,</t> <t>Tulenu ulo nile ya di elu;</t> <t>Ka unu we kọrọ ọb͕ọ nēso n'azu.</t>
<t>N'ihi na Nka bu Chineke, bú Chineke-ayi, rue mb͕e nile ebighi-ebi;</t> <t>Ya onwe-ya ganēdu ayi rue n'inwu-ọnwu.</t>
